name: qiongli-literature-provider
description: Qiongli academic literature provider MCPB for local OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref, PubMed, and arXiv search, advanced result controls, credential status, and secure setup.

tools.name: qiongli_config_status
tools.description: Return redacted Qiongli provider configuration status.

tools.name: qiongli_save_provider_config
tools.description: Save explicit Qiongli provider config values from chat or scripts. Prefer qiongli_configure_provider for API keys.

tools.name: qiongli_configure_provider
tools.description: Start a tokenized loopback setup page and return its URL for provider configuration. Prefer this for API keys so secrets do not enter chat history.

tools.name: qiongli_literature_status
tools.description: Report configured literature providers and capability mode without exposing secrets.

tools.name: qiongli_search_plan
tools.description: Plan provider and platform-native literature search routing without executing search.

tools.name: qiongli_literature_search
tools.description: Search academic literature using the providers available in the active Qiongli runtime profile.

tools.name: qiongli_literature_export_evidence
tools.description: Export an auditable provider capability, search plan, diagnostics, and result snapshot.

tools.name: qiongli_zotero_status
tools.description: Report local Zotero Desktop connector, Qiongli companion, and import-file fallback availability.

tools.name: qiongli_zotero_search
tools.description: Search the user's local Zotero library through the bounded loopback Qiongli Companion.

tools.name: qiongli_zotero_upsert_references
tools.description: Preview or explicitly apply a receipt-bound reference upsert through the local Qiongli Zotero Companion.

tools.name: qiongli_zotero_export_import_files
tools.description: Generate Zotero-compatible CSL-JSON, RIS, BibTeX, and import-report files from Qiongli references.

tools.name: qiongli_orchestrator_route
tools.description: Decide whether the active client should use skill-only routing or Full Qiongli orchestration.

tools.name: qiongli_task_plan
tools.description: Render a Qiongli task execution plan without launching runtime agents.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key
openalex_api_key.description: OpenAlex API key from openalex.org/settings/api. Leave blank to skip OpenAlex provider calls.

openalex_email.title: OpenAlex email
openalex_email.description: Optional email address included in OpenAlex requests as mailto contact metadata.

semantic_scholar_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key
semantic_scholar_api_key.description: Semantic Scholar API key. Leave blank to use only unauthenticated provider paths.

crossref_email.title: Crossref polite access email
crossref_email.description: Optional email address included in Crossref requests for polite access. Crossref does not require a public API key for standard REST API calls.

pubmed_api_key.title: NCBI API key
pubmed_api_key.description: Optional NCBI API key for PubMed E-Utilities requests. Leave blank to skip the bundled PubMed provider.

default_result_limit.title: Default result limit
default_result_limit.description: Default results per provider for non-review searches when a tool call does not specify limit or per_provider_limit. Non-review mode uses 25 by default; review mode uses 50 by default and accepts explicit per-provider limits up to 200.

zotero_local_enabled.title: Enable local Zotero bridge
zotero_local_enabled.description: When enabled, Qiongli can probe the local Zotero Desktop connector and Qiongli Zotero companion extension on the loopback interface.

zotero_connector_url.title: Local Zotero connector URL
zotero_connector_url.description: Loopback URL for Zotero Desktop's local connector server. The default is http://127.0.0.1:23119.

zotero_default_collection_path.title: Default Zotero collection path
zotero_default_collection_path.description: Optional collection path used when writing references through the Qiongli Zotero companion.

zotero_write_policy.title: Local Zotero write policy
zotero_write_policy.description: Controls local Zotero writes. Use explicit to require tool-call intent before non-dry-run writes.

zotero_update_policy.title: Local Zotero update policy
zotero_update_policy.description: Controls whether Qiongli only fills blank local Zotero fields or may prefer enriched metadata.

zotero_default_review_tags.title: Default Zotero review tags
zotero_default_review_tags.description: Comma-separated Qiongli tags added to Zotero imports that still need review.

zotero_default_review_collection_path.title: Default Zotero review collection path
zotero_default_review_collection_path.description: Optional collection path for newly imported references that need review.

zotero_crossref_verification_enabled.title: Verify Zotero imports with Crossref DOI metadata
zotero_crossref_verification_enabled.description: When enabled, DOI-bearing Zotero imports use Crossref registry metadata to fill blank fields and report conflicts.
